stem:
Cloves are the aromatic flower buds of the tree *Syzygium aromaticum*. Eugenol is a drug extracted from cloves.

Eugenol affects the movement of sodium ions through the cell surface membranes of sensory neurones.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Describe the effect of eugenol concentration on the percentage decrease in sodium ion movement.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Using Fig. 6.1, determine the percentage decrease in sodium ion movement at a eugenol concentration of $0.5\text{ mmol dm}^{-3}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Eugenol can be used to relieve the pain of toothache by putting it onto the affected tooth and gum.

Suggest **and** explain how the action of eugenol may reduce pain.
